strings: m_c has been having a lot of trouble keeping up while playing. r_c0 listens to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} chest and diagnoses {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with raspy lungs.
As m_c grows, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/seem/seems} incapable of not snoring and panting loudly, until eventually it's clear {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} lungs are a little weaker than normal.
